pendingTriage.author: OliWarner
pendingTriage.contentPreview: SpotOn recommendations on Don't Stop The Music are really tight. They seem to always include the same artist.  Is there any way of loosening this up a bit?
pendingTriage.draft:
Hey OliWarner,

Thanks for the feedback — you're touching on something that's a known limitation with how SpotOn's Autoplay/Don't Stop The Music integration currently works.

The short version: SpotOn uses Spotify's recommendations API seeded from the currently playing track/artist, which tends to produce fairly similar results by default. The "same artist keeps appearing" behaviour is a common complaint and is something we'd like to improve.

There's an open enhancement request related to this — [B]Issue #117[/B] covers the fact that SpotOn's Autoplay silently overrides the Don't Stop The Music setting rather than integrating cleanly with it. Wider recommendation variety is part of that same conversation.

A few things that [I]may[/I] help in the meantime:

[LIST]
[*]Make sure you've played a good variety of tracks before DSTM kicks in — the seed Spotify uses matters a lot
[*]Check whether your Spotify account has a broad listening history; the recommendations API draws on that
[/LIST]

That said, I won't pretend there's a setting you're missing that fixes this — the tightness you're seeing is largely a function of how the Spotify recommendations endpoint behaves with a single seed.

If you want to help shape how this gets improved, feel free to add a comment on the GitHub issue with your specific experience:

[URL]https://github.com/stiefenm/spoton/issues/117[/URL]

The more concrete examples we have of what users expect vs. what they get, the better we can prioritise and spec out a fix.

Ha, I appreciate the kind words, woOrszt! 😄

[B]OliWarner[/B] — yes, please give [B]v3.1.3[/B] a try! The update includes some changes aimed at broadening recommendation variety, so the "same artist on repeat" behaviour should be noticeably improved.

That said, I want to be transparent: the underlying recommendations come from Spotify's API, so there's a limit to how much we can tune on our end. If after updating to 3.1.3 you're still finding the suggestions too narrow, it would really help to know:

[LIST]
[*]What kind of seed tracks/artists tend to trigger it?
[*]Are you seeing the same artist repeatedly, or just the same general genre/mood?
[/LIST]

Also worth noting — there's an open issue ([URL=https://github.com/stiefenm/spoton/issues/117]#117[/URL]) tracking the fact that SpotOn's Autoplay can silently override LMS's native Don't Stop The Music setting. If your experience is more about [I]which[/I] feature is actually driving playback rather than recommendation quality itself, that issue might be relevant context.

If 3.1.3 doesn't improve things to your satisfaction, please open a GitHub issue with some details: [URL=https://github.com/stiefenm/spoton/issues]https://github.com/stiefenm/spoton/issues[/URL] — and grab a diagnostic bundle from [B]SpotOn Settings → Diagnostics[/B] if you can, it helps a lot in tracking down what seeds are being passed to the API.
